title: HUP iEEG Epilepsy Dataset
description: De-identified intracranial EEG recordings from 58 patients undergoing surgical evaluation for drug-resistant epilepsy at the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania. Recordings used subdural grid, strip, and depth electrodes (ECoG) or stereotactically placed depth electrodes (SEEG), and include interictal and ictal periods. The dataset provides electrode localizations in ICBM152 MNI space, clinically determined seizure onset channels, and channels overlapping the resection or ablation zone segmented from the resection cavity.
methods_description: Patients underwent intracranial EEG with ECoG or SEEG electrodes and subsequently received surgical resection or laser ablation. Electrodes were localized in ICBM152 MNI space, and resection zones were determined by segmenting the resection cavity. The data were converted to BIDS format using MNE-BIDS.
